items.text: Operation theatre, anaesthesia and perfusion technology careers involve preparing equipment, supporting surgical and anaesthesia teams and, in perfusion, operating heart-lung machines during cardiac surgery, and they need recognised training, strict infection control and the ability to stay calm during critical procedures.
Check the official bodies before enrolling and avoid agents who guarantee jobs.
high income opportunities come from finished work in one lane.
